Notification No. NPSC/EXAM-4/2018 dt. 30.03.2026 (Limited Departmental Examination 2022) 
 Published on : 30-03-2026 02:18 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 NAGALAND: KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC/EXAM-4/2018 Dated Kohima, the 30 th March,
2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 In compliance with the Hon’ble
Gauhati High Court Kohima Bench’s Order vide W.P.(C) No.171/2022 dated
07.11.2025 and in pursuance of Advertisement No.NPSC-1/LDE/2022 dated
01.07.2022 this is to notify all the candidates of Examination schedule. 
 1. The Examination for Limited
Departmental Examination (LDE) shall be held 
 w.e.f 6 th May, 2026 onwards. 
 2. Eligible candidates can download the Admission Certificate
(containing details of routine, instructions, etc) at https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in from 30 th 
April, 2026, 12:00 Noon. 
 3. C andidates
are instructed to furnish their Service
ID or Aadhaar card for ID proof
along with the Admit Card at the time of written examination.
